properties.description: Carries symmetric / antisymmetric, transitive, functional, inverse-of and compositions in each relationship's declared reading (backfilled from the three-graph classification); routes every meaning-selecting computation through that algebra so a method that cannot represent it refuses and says why; and mines the regularities the instance data follows, reporting declared rules the data breaks and undeclared regularities it follows, each with its instances.
properties.name: Each relationship's algebra is declared in its reading, a method refuses a relationship whose algebra it cannot represent, and the declared algebra is checked against the design's own data
